_comment: sim-robust-place-wrist3-settle-v1 bounded collect-only GPU proof. Purpose: prove the loaded collect PLACE-on-cart settles at its endpoint and the collect completes through stow, instead of the coldwin2 (2026-10-23) false-fail where ur_wrist_3 rang at 0.72 rad/s at a 3.4 mm-accurate pose and TRAJ_HOST_FAULT 'measured goal tolerance not reached' aborted the place (PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=place -> 'arm command heartbeat lost'). The fix is in scripts/twin/restock/trajectory_host.py: an integrated terminal-settle criterion (settle_decision) that accepts a bounded DECAYING residual oscillation at a tight pose as a settled place BY NAME, and fails a sustained/diverging/unbounded one BY NAME. Position tolerance is NOT loosened. Run under the full capstone keys (coldwin2 config) through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never --force, never touching whispr.
_how_to_run: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... --stop-after collect  (ends right after collect/pick/place-on-cart/stow, so couple/outbound are not reached). Use the SAME mission-runtime-capstone config coldwin2 used (PR 227-238 keys, economy on, station widen dropped). RESTOCK_SETTLE_ENVELOPE defaults ON -- no config/env change is required to get the fix; the keys below are only for tuning/repro.

_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_ENVELOPE: default ON (absent => enabled). Set to 0/false/off/no to reproduce the legacy instantaneous-only gate (coldwin2's false-fail) for an A/B.
_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_MIN_WINDOW_S: default 3.0 -- min SIM seconds of terminal observation before the envelope may settle/classify (anti lucky-dip).
_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_MIN_SAMPLES: default 8 -- min distinct feedback samples before the envelope may settle/classify.
_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_DECAY_RATIO: default 0.6 -- recent velocity-peak must be <= this fraction of the earliest peak to count as decaying (not a limit cycle).
_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_ACCEPT_VEL: default 1.0 rad/s -- recent velocity-peak ceiling to accept a decaying residual (clamped >= the 0.70 instantaneous vel tol).
_env_switches.RESTOCK_SETTLE_DIVERGE_RATIO: default 1.25 -- recent peak above this x the earlier peak (and over the vel tol) => fail 'diverging' early.

_expected_pass: The place-on-cart completes: host-stack.log shows either the existing TRAJ_HOST success (instantaneous) OR a new 'TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_SETTLE decaying residual oscillation at tight pose ...' line, NO 'TRAJ_HOST_FAULT measured goal tolerance not reached', NO 'PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED', NO 'HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=place'; the collect stage reports succeeded through stow. Repeat the collect-only run if cheap to confirm it is not luck.
_diagnostic_if_still_fails: The new throttled 'TRAJ_HOST_SETTLE settle=.. pos_err=.. vel=.. per_joint_vel=[..]' trace lines (every ~1 s SIM over the settle window) now record the wrist_3 envelope that the coldwin2 log never captured. If the place fails with 'sustained residual oscillation (limit cycle, not damping)' or 'pose not bounded', the wrist_3 ring did NOT decay within the window -- that is a genuine effort-saturation limit cycle under the welded carton (the PD drive wants ~6330 Nm at 0.72 rad/s vs the 400 Nm cap, 16x saturated; the linear drive is overdamped, so this is saturation, not gains). That is a drive/weld physics follow-up for the integration/arm-stack owner, not a trajectory_host tolerance; report the TRAJ_HOST_SETTLE envelope (early->recent peak) so the decay rate is quantified.
_gpu_rules: One GPU run at a time via flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock; never --force; never touch whispr (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB). coldwin2 peaked 10547 MiB; headroom is tight on the 12 GB card.
